predeclared_acceptance.energy: Candidate increment <= shared-schedule original increment minus shared-schedule original G2P cumulative channel, plus unchanged ledger roundoff. Mechanism-derived target fixed prospectively; invalid updates cannot qualify.
predeclared_acceptance.shape: Candidate versus shared-schedule original global Linf and L2 errors in x,F,J,C,plastic_strain,damage must fit prior original dt1/dt2/dt4 temporal-spread envelope plus64eps roundoff. Diagnostic screen only.
predeclared_acceptance.physical: All original physical/contact gates at every real shared step. Authenticate original dt1 replay against saved35 arrays and energy channels. Both candidate runs call the same candidate.step compiled executable; host diagnostics collection cannot change its graph; final35 arrays bitwise required.
predeclared_acceptance.scope: No production, fragment, or public media admission.
predeclared_acceptance.schedule: At every real step dt=min(original CFL,candidate CFL,remaining to135ns); both states advance with exactly same dt. Halt after first invalid step;512-step cap. Authenticate old dt1 replay independently.
predeclared_acceptance.baseline_authentication: Use exact producer original.advance_to and original advance_to_traced wrappers at CFL.1, compare all35 original/probe/saved arrays bitwise, prescribed original dt1 trace bytes exactly, and all original per-step energy channels within64eps. New scan wrappers are excluded from baseline authentication.
predeclared_acceptance.additional_transfer: Every real step must satisfy per-field angular roundoff, convex kinetic identity roundoff, alpha in[0,1] and nonnegative blend variance. These add gates; previous energy/shape/physical gates remain unchanged.
predeclared_acceptance.operator: Complete APIC/delta v,C blend with same global scalar alpha=exp(-dt/tau0); tau0 frozen from original exact125ns crossing, no fit/sweep.

report_serialization: Convert NumPy scalar values with .item() only; preserve boolean gates, reject unsupported objects and nonfinite JSON. No numerical or acceptance change.

coefficient.reference: tau0=original exact125ns stable_dt/CFL; CFL=.1; one grid-cell crossing under original maximum characteristic/affine/viscous signal speed
coefficient.no_tuning: No free multiplier, alpha sweep, candidate-cloud fitting or shape-envelope fitting. Freeze tau0 for whole125--135ns study; use actual shared admissible dt each step.

quota_review_policy: No dispatch until root can reliably read weekly UI usage below90%; unknown or>=90% means stop. At most one dispatch. Current preparation/push is source only.
